create_slab_from_bulk: create a Slab object from a bulk structure by sampling a random Miller index and shift
compute_all_slabs: compute all symmetrically distinct slabs from a bulk structure up to a given max Miller index
tag_surface_atoms: tag atoms in a slab as surface or bulk using Voronoi coordination and height heuristics
tile_slab_atoms: tile a slab structure along the a and b lattice vectors to reach a minimum size
flip_slab_structure: flip a slab structure upside down to expose the bottom surface as the top
